facts.text: Languages spoken here include French, Lingala and Swahili.

culture.text: Congolese rumba is a music and dance tradition shared by the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of the Congo.

food.name: Moambe
food.text: A dish featuring palm nuts and chicken, served with accompaniments such as rice and vegetables.
